| 5065 | ਮੈਨੀਸੰਗਤਿ | 5 | 90 | Khatri by caste. Fateh Chand Maini, resident of Patna, was a disciple of Guru Tegbahadur. As a child, Guru Gobind Singh used to indulge in playfulness in the house of Fateh Chand. The pious wife of Fateh Chand used to serve him puris, milk, fried grams. The place at the residence of Fateh Chand where devotees would gather is popularly known as Maini Sangat and puris and grams are served to the devotees at this holy shrine even today. This sacred place is situated not far away from Harmandir (the birth place of Guru Gobind Singh). The shoes of the Guru and the fruit tree of that time can still be seen at this place. This gurdwara is also named as Chhoti Sangat. The priests are Singhs belonging to the Nirmala sect. | long_definition |
| 5066 | ਮੋਤੀਆਬਿੰਦ | 5 | 90 | ॥ भुवर्हिट. pearl-sized drop of fluid in the eye that hinders proper vision. نزول المها cataract. Initially, vision becomes dim, which goes on decreasing as moisture gets dense. Ultimately this dense moisture turns into a layer of the size of pearls and completely covers the vision. Then this eye defect is termed as ਮੋਤੀਆਬਿੰਦ (a pearl like spot). The reasons for this deformity are: old age, diabetes, syphilis, epilepsy, intake of some poisonous matter, injury on the head, weakness of the brain, obstruction of the excrements, indulgence in excessive sexual intercourse, crying and wailing in excess, eating spicy food, pickles etc, loitering barefoot in the sun, taking overdose of drinks and intoxicants etc. The best treatment of cataract is to get it operated from an experienced surgeon. If the cataract is in the initial stage, the following treatments can be beneficial: 1. Grind seeds of indigo plant and apply this fine powder in the eye like collyrium powder. 2. Take laxatives and easily digestible food. 3. Take such diet as gives strength to the brain. 4. Take equal amounts of chebulic myrobalan, belleric myrobalan, aule (emblic myrobalan), outer shell of hen's eggs, ferrous sulphate, calx of iron, blue lotus, barbərīg, sea foam. Mix a little of goat's milk in this mixture and grind in a copper mortar for 30 quarters of a day (one quarter = 3 hours) till it becomes fine like collyrium powder. Now put more of goat's milk so as to make a soft paste and prepare thin sticks. Applying these sticks to the eye like collyrium power is very beneficial. 5. Kill a black snake, put a small lump of collyrium in its mouth, put it in an earthen pot and bury it in earth for about a month. Take it out and grind it in a mortar, mix one tola of so prepared collyrium with six mashas of calx of jasmine flowers and three mashas of lead salt (powdered lead). Apply this to your eye just like collyrium. | long_definition |
| 5067 | ਮੋਤੀਆਬਿੰਦੁ | 5 | 90 | ॥ भुवर्हिट. pearl-sized drop of fluid in the eye that hinders proper vision. نزول المها cataract. Initially, vision becomes dim, which goes on decreasing as moisture gets dense. Ultimately this dense moisture turns into a layer of the size of pearls and completely covers the vision. Then this eye defect is termed as ਮੋਤੀਆਬਿੰਦ (a pearl like spot). The reasons for this deformity are: old age, diabetes, syphilis, epilepsy, intake of some poisonous matter, injury on the head, weakness of the brain, obstruction of the excrements, indulgence in excessive sexual intercourse, crying and wailing in excess, eating spicy food, pickles etc, loitering barefoot in the sun, taking overdose of drinks and intoxicants etc. The best treatment of cataract is to get it operated from an experienced surgeon. If the cataract is in the initial stage, the following treatments can be beneficial: 1. Grind seeds of indigo plant and apply this fine powder in the eye like collyrium powder. 2. Take laxatives and easily digestible food. 3. Take such diet as gives strength to the brain. 4. Take equal amounts of chebulic myrobalan, belleric myrobalan, aule (emblic myrobalan), outer shell of hen's eggs, ferrous sulphate, calx of iron, blue lotus, barbərīg, sea foam. Mix a little of goat's milk in this mixture and grind in a copper mortar for 30 quarters of a day (one quarter = 3 hours) till it becomes fine like collyrium powder. Now put more of goat's milk so as to make a soft paste and prepare thin sticks. Applying these sticks to the eye like collyrium power is very beneficial. 5. Kill a black snake, put a small lump of collyrium in its mouth, put it in an earthen pot and bury it in earth for about a month. Take it out and grind it in a mortar, mix one tola of so prepared collyrium with six mashas of calx of jasmine flowers and three mashas of lead salt (powdered lead). Apply this to your eye just like collyrium. | long_definition |

| 5069 | ਮੰਗਲਾਚਰਣ | 6 | 90 | n auspicious occasion, festivity. 2 worship or prayer to spiritual mentor at the beginning of a scripture; preface. | 5072 | ਯਥਾਸੰਖ੍ਯ | 5 | 90 | Skt ਯਥਾਸੰਖ੍ਯਮ੍. adv in sequence, in serial order. 2 n figurative embellishment that explains the meaning. If the sequence of related objects is mentioned in the traditional order, the figurative expression is called yəthasəkhy. It is also named ਪ੍ਰਸੰਖ੍ਯਾ and yəthakrəm. krəm sõ kəhı tın ke ərəth krəm sõ bəhur mılay, yəthasəkhy tāko kəhẽ bhuşən je kəvıray. –ਸ਼ਿਵਰਾਜਭੂਸ਼ਨ. Example: guru isəru guru gorəkhu bərma, guru parbəti mai.–ਜਪੁ. In this verse isər (lord Shiv), gorakh (Vishnu) and Brahma mentioned are followed by three goddesses (their wives) in sequence i.e. Parbəti, Ma (Laxmi) and Ee (Sarsvati). ਪਰਤ੍ਰੀਯ ਦੀਰਘ ਸਮਾਨ ਲਘੁ ਯਾਵਦੇਕ, ਜਨਨੀ ਭਗਨੀ ਸੁਤਾ ਰੂਪਕੇ ਨਿਹਾਰੀਏ. –BGK. In this verse, dirəgh, səman, ləghu are related with jənənı, bhəgənı and suta respectively. (b) describing the numbers 1, 2, 3, . in sequence without any break comprises the second variation of yəthasəkhy. Example: ਪਹਿਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਲਗਾ ਥਨ ਦੁਧਿ, ਦੂਜੇ ਮਾਤ ਬਾਪ ਕੀ ਸੁਧਿ, ਤੀਜੇ ਭਯਾ ਭਾਬੀ ਬੇਬ, ਚੌਥੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਉਪੰਨੀ ਖੇਦ, põjve khan piən ki dhatu, chive kamu nə puche jati, sətve sõjı kia ghərvasu, ǝthve krodhu hoa tən nasu, nave dhǝule ubhesah, dəsvɛ dədha hoa suah. —m 1 var majh. (c) describing an object without naming but by relating with it a well-known number is the third type of yǝthasəkhy. Example: tih kərı rəkhe põjkərı sathi, nau setanu matu kəțijai. —sri m 1. Here the number ਡੀਵ [tih] represents thirty fasts (observed on 30 days of Ramzaan month) and the number five stands for Muslim prayers held five times a day. carı pukarəhı na tu manəhı, khəțu bhi eka bat vəkhanəhı, dəs-əsți mılı eko kəhıa, tã bhi jogi bhedu nə ləhza. —ram m 5. | 5108 | ਵਿਕਸਵਰ | 5 | 90 | Skt adj shining, luminous. 2 n a literary device. | 5111 | ਵਿਚਿਤ੍ਰਸਿੰਘ | 6 | 90 | son of Mani Ram Rajput and a real brother of Uday Singh. He was a devout follower of Guru Gobind Singh. In Sammat 1758, the hill chiefs laid siege to Anandpur and instigated an intoxicated elephant to rush forward to break open the door of the Lohgarh fort. By the orders of the tenth Master, the valiant Vichitar Singh hit with a lance the forehead of the elephant so forcefully that it entered the forehead of the elephant. Consequently, the elephant rushed back and trampled the army of the hill chiefs. Bhai Santokh Singh writes thus about this episode: ਤਬ ਵਿਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਿੰਘ ਰਿਦੇ ਵਿਚਾਰਯੋ, ਇਹ ਅਵਸਰ ਅਬ ਮੇਰਾ, ਹਤੋ ਮਤੰਗ ਅੱਗ ਮੇ ਬਰਛਾ, ਕਰਕੇ ਓਜ ਘਨੇਰਾ, ਚਰਬਟ ਓਥਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਿਲੋਚਨ, ਫਰਕਤ ਮੁਛ ਉਠਾਈ. ਭ੍ਰਿਕੁਟੀ ਚਢੀ ਕੁਟਿਲ, ਮੁਖ ਲਾਲੀ, ਸਮਸ ਮਹਾਂ ਛਬਿ ਛਾਈ. ਪੱਗ ਕੋ ਬਲ ਰਕਾਬ ਪਰ ਕਰਕੇ, ਉਛਰਯੋ ਆਸਨ ਛੋਰਾ, ਸਭਿ ਸ਼ਰੀਰ ਕੋ ਓਜ ਸੰਭਰ ਕੇ, ਹਯ ਫਾਢਯੋ ਗਜ ਓਰਾ, ਸੇਫ ਬਚਾਇ ਚਲਾਇ ਸੁ ਬਰਛਾ, ਤਵਾ ਫੁਲਾਦੀ ਫੋਰਾ, ਧਸਯੋ ਜਾਇ ਗਜ ਮਸਤਕ ਮੇ ਜਬ, ਪੁਨ ਕਰ ਜੁਗ ਕਰ ਜੋਰਾ, ਕਰਯੋ ਧਸਾਵਨ ਪ੍ਰਵਿਸਯੋ ਏਸੇ, ਉਪਮਾ ਕਹੋ ਬਨਾਈ, ਕ੍ਰੋਚ ਸੇਲ ਮੇ ਜਨੁ ਸਿਵਨਦਨ, ਬਰਛੀ ਮਾਰ ਧਸਾਈ, ਵਾਸੁਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਧੋ ਬੇਗ ਕਰ ਦਿਰਾਘ, ਵਿੰਤਾਸੁਤ ਕੇ ਤ੍ਰਾਸਾ, ਦੇਖ ਰੰਧ੍ਰ ਗਿਰੀ ਵਿਖੇ ਪ੍ਰਵੇਸਯੋ, ਨਹਿ ਪੁਨ ਬਦਨ ਨਿਕਾਸਾ. –GPS. | 5113 | ਵਿਰੋਧਾਭਾਸ | 5 | 90 | reflection or semblance of a paradox; a literary device used in a poetic composition to show a paradox that in fact, is not there. jəhĩ virodh so ləgət he hoy nə sac virodh, kəhıt virodhabhas təhī budhjən buddhi vibodh. -ləlıtləlam. Example: min məre jəl ke pərse kəb-hu nə məre pər pavək pae, hathı mərə məd ke pərse kəb-hu nə məre tən tap ke ae, tiy mərɛ pətı ke pərse kəb-hu nə məre pərdes sidhae, gudh me bat kəhi dıjraj Vıcar səkɛ nə bına cit lae. -bhai dhānasĩgh, dəşmeş da həjuri kəvı. | 5117 | ਵ੍ਯਾਜਉਕ੍ਤਿ | 6 | 90 | ਦਜਾੱਤ-ਵਿ dissimulating state- 2 Thinking that one's secret misdeeds may not have a bad effect on the people, and in order to conceal one's misdeeds, inventing and conveying some such facts as help to avoid the blame is vyjajoktı. an hetu sõ apno jəhã chıpave rup, vyaj ukətı tako kəhıt bhuşən sukəvı ənup. -şıvrajbhuşən. | 5118 | ਵਜ਼ੀਰਖਾਨ | 5 | 90 | Hakim Alim-ud-din, son of Sheikh Abdul-Latif who was known as Wazir Khan. He was a resident of Chinot. | 5137 | ਸਿੰਘਾਵਲੋਕਨ | 6 | 90 | n an analogy according to which one should re-examine and re-consider the subject of one’s statement, as a lion repeatedly withdraws and reexamines its kill. 2 In poetry it is a verbal device according to which the same word occurs in the beginning of a succeeding line in a different sense from the one used at the end of the preceding line, as: mar mənīd bīkārən brīd bələd khəgīd bəlī səm mar, mar həkār-hī krodh-hī lobh-hī moh səmūl-hī det upar, par kəre nijsevək ke gən de dhan ko sətīnam udar, darən dut təjë sun nam nəmo guru nanək kalukumar.-NP. kərni sukh, dukh darıd hərni, hərnisut səm ākhən bərni. bərni bəkr məhã chəbi dhərni, dhərni budhi ki be tən tərni. tərni bıghənsidhu jıh sərni, sərnirəj dutı drıg adərni. dərni dokhən das udhərni, dhərni kəruna gunzyən bərni. bərni kõd îdu abhərni, bhərni nag bıghən gən ərni. ərni kərə ənəd usərni, sərni pərə kəles nıvərni.-GPS. | long_definition |
| 5138 | ਸਿੱਖਧਰਮ | 5 | 90 | Religion is the path that great personages have chalked out to show the way for realising the purpose of human life.¹ Of several paths shown by religion, the main path is the one that the ten masters from Guru Nanak Dev to Guru Gobind Singh have shown. It is known as sıkkdhərəm, and the basic rules of this religion are as under : The chief purpose of religion is not to land in heaven, but attain oneness with the Supreme Creator through constant concentration on Him, without which the cycle of life and death does not terminate. The form of the Creator is : “ਇਕ ਓੰਕਾਰ ਸਤਿਨਾਮੁ, ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ, ਨਿਰਭਉ, ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ, ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ, ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ, ਗੁਰਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ.” i.e., God is the matchless one, ever indestructible, creator of all inhering His creation.² Unlike the gods He fears none, nor does He frighten His foes and is ever blissful. He is immune to birth and death, creates all and is created by none. Through the grace of that Supreme Light everything is attainable. To be one with the Creator one needs a guide embodied by the ten Gurus whose complete being is vested in Guru Granth Sahib.³ The votaries of Satguru who expound the | long_definition |

| 5143 | ਸੁਭਟੇਦ੍ਰ | 5 | 90 | adj leader of warriors. 2 n general, chieftain. 3 a metre containing four lines, 24 matras in each line, first pause on the 13th, second on the next 11th matra and a guru, laghu in the end or a couplet of four lines, all the four lines rhyming. Example: sərər sərər jəb cədhət dəl səj kər sīgh subir. bərər bərər bərrat ripu bıhbəl bıkəl şərir, bhərər bhərər bhəy bhəjət bhi bılpət bəhu bhət bhir, mərər mərər kali cəbɛ ərət ju dust bəhir. —sıkkhi prəbhakər. | long_definition |
| 5144 | ਸੂਨ੍ਯਵਾਦ | 5 | 90 | Skt n a sect that terms 'nothing' as the cause of everything; a branch of Buddhism. There was nothing before this world came into existence. The world came into existence by chance. It will come to nothing in the end according to this doctrine. | long_definition |
| 5145 | ਸੋਫਿਸਟਾਈ | 5 | 90 | G This sect was very powerful in Greece during the times of Socrates the philosopher. By installing new deities against the old ones and by staging dramas it misled the country men. Socrates refuted this cult with force and showed the true way of life to the people. | long_definition |
| 5146 | ਸ੍ਰੋਣਪਾਤ | 5 | 90 | flowing of blood is of many types. Three types are important (a) flowing of blood through the mouth, ears and nose. (b) flowing of blood from the rectum, vagina and penis. (c) flowing of blood through pores of the skin. Treatment should begin on the advice of a wise physician so that the patient gets relief from pain. Learned physicians have described main causes of sronpat as follows - going about in scorching heat, doing exercise in excess, excessive indulgence in sex, excessive use of chillies, hot food and spices, drinking of liquor, and eating acidic food. Due to these, blood gets infected and starts simmering and develops these infections. The best medicine to cure this disease is: Take one tola each of coriander, emblic myrobalan (ǝula) bāsa, munəkka dakh (large sized dried grapes), and pit papra, and crush them to barley size.¹ Soak the mixture in water overnight, and take the coarsely crushed stuff with lump sugar. | long_definition |
| 5147 | ਸ੍ਵਭਾਵੋਕਤਿ | 6 | 90 | a figure of speech dealing with description of the exact nature of things. Its another name is jati. Example: ləuki əthsəthi tirəthi nai. kəurapən təu nə jai.-sor kəbir. cədən lep hot deh kau sukh gərdhəbh biəsəm səgitı.--dhəna m 5. mənmukh mən nə bhījəi əti male cit kǝthor səpe dudh piaiɛ ədərı visu nikor.-suhi ə m 3. | long_definition |
| 5148 | ਸ੍ਵਰਗਵਾਸ | 6 | 90 | residence in heaven and the resident of heaven. 2 This word is used as a mark of respect for the people who are no more in this world (dead) even if their souls have gone to hell. Such religious feelings impel people to use words like Kailashvasi, Gurupurnivasi, Golo-kvasi and Vaikunth nivasi. | long_definition |
| 5149 | ਸ੍ਵਰਗਵਾਸੀ | 6 | 90 | residence in heaven and the resident of heaven. 2 This word is used as a mark of respect for the people who are no more in this world (dead) even if their souls have gone to hell. Such religious feelings impel people to use words like Kailashvasi, Gurupurnivasi, Golo-kvasi and Vaikunth nivasi. | long_definition |
| 5150 | ਸ੍ਵਾਤੀਬੂੰਦ | 5 | 90 | n rain fallen in svati. It is written in the Purans that the thirst of the rain bird is quenched with this rain-water only. When a drop of this rain falls, a pearl gets formed in the oyster, a banslochan (a colloidal concretion found in the stems of bamboos) is formed in the bamboo, and camphor grows in the banana. Astrologers hold that all days of the light half of Harh (mid June to mid July) and the seventh day of Magh Badi, if it is lunar asterism, are svatiyog. | long_definition |
| 5151 | ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀਦਾਸ | 5 | 90 | Nanda, Vithar and Swamidas were three business men of Thanesar. They became the true votaries of Guru Arjan Dev. The Guru preached them to be honest in their profession and true to their word. They acted upon the Guru's preaching and became famous as “ikk sukhnie.” | long_definition |
| 5152 | ਸ੍ਵੇਤਕੁਸ਼ਟ | 6 | 90 | Leucoderma. برص This disease happens due to impurity of blood. Some times a child inherits it from his parents. According to Ayurved it is of two types: svītr and kīlas. The spots of svītr are white and those of kīlas have reddish hue. If these spots ooze out blood when pricked with a needle then the cure may be easy, and if they ooze out white or yellow discharge then the cure is very difficult. The best cures of leucoderma are as under: First of all use liquid medicines and do not let faeces stick in the intestine. Soak the seeds of babci in cow’s urine, remove the peel and dry them in shade. Keep this in a bottle after grinding. Give one masa powder daily with a decoction made with mūdi buṭi (gorəkh mūdi) Apply this powder on white marks. Give gram-flour bread to the patient. Take six masas each of bij pəvar, babci, əjmod, məjith, sulphurized myrobalan raddish seeds, vərki hərtal, seeds of jəmalgota, tutia, seeds of pəlas, hira kəsis. Grind the mixture to powder and soak this powder in vinegar and then make small tablets. Afterwards rub this tablet in vinegar, make paste and apply the paste on white marks. If there are blisters on the skin due to this paste, apply some butter to them. Crush the slough of a cobra in the milk of cactus and apply this paste on white marks. Take kəth, peel of əhera and root of fig tree. Boil these in water and prepare a medicinal decoction. Give this to the patient with one masa powder of babci. Rub sixteen tolas of babci seeds of four tolas of vərki hərtal, one tola each of mansil, white rəttkā, root of chītra in cow urine and apply this paste on the marks. In this way leucoderma will be totally cured. “svetkust keṭin ke bhayo.”—cəritr 405. | long_definition |
| 5153 | ਸ੍ਵੇਤਕੁਸ਼ਠ | 6 | 90 | Leucoderma. برص This disease happens due to impurity of blood. Some times a child inherits it from his parents. According to Ayurved it is of two types: svītr and kīlas. | 5154 | ਸੰਗਲੀਆਲਾ | 5 | 90 | adj sequential, joined with chains. "ghure nagare dohre rən səgliale." -cədi var. 'Two war drums which are beaten by placing them on the back of a horse or a camel, are tied with a chain so that they may not get separated.' | long_definition |
| 5155 | ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਣੀ | 5 | 90 | Skt संग्रहणी. زرب مزمن psilosis. The causes of this disease are as those of dysentery. This disease is often a chronic form of diarrhoea or dysentery. A patient of psilosis suffers from loose motions; his intestine gives out noise, his mouth waters; he has back-aches and this disease is severe during the day and less painful at night. If a psilosis patient skips meals for 40 days and takes yoghurt of cow or goat milk mixed with some salt, black pepper and powder of ginger, he recovers without any medicine. The medicines beneficial for dysentery should be used for psilosis. The digestive powder thus prepared is also very useful. Take pure sulphur one tola, pure mercury half tola, and pulverise both of these. Also take ginger, black pepper, piper longum, fried asafoetida, white and black cumin seeds one tola each, five kinds of salts seven and a half tolas and cannabis measuring half of all these medicines. After grinding and sieving all these, mix with the above pulverized medicine and put the mixture in a small bottle. Eat three masas of this medicine with churned curd of cow milk everyday. Take boiled and sieved rice free of gruel in meal. “səgrəhņi səgrəh dusţən kıy."-cərıtr 405. | long_definition |
| 5156 | ਸੰਤੋਖਪੁਰਾ | 5 | 90 | There is a gurdwara related to Guru Gobind Singh in a forest owned by the government, situated near Darpur road which is one and a half mile to the east of Chhachhrauli, in Kalsia state district Ambala. Previously there was no such gurdwara. On the 1st of November 1920, this place was discovered through the efforts of Sant Khalsa Harnam Singh of Mastuana. This gurdwara is situated at a distance of 8 miles to the east of Jagadhari railway station, approachable by a metalled road. A fair is held on the 7th Poh Sudi of the Bikrami calendar. | long_definition |
| 5157 | ਹਰਿਗੀਤਿਕਾ | 5 | 90 | a poetic metre. Its stanza has four lines, each line having 28 matras. The first pause is at the 16th matra and the second at the final 12th. Each line ends with lǝghu guru or a rəgən, that is, SIS. Example: “səbhı dron gırıvər sıkhər tər nər, pap kərəm bhǝe məno, uth bhaj dhərm səbhərm hve chəmkət damənı so məno.” . -kəlki. (b) There is a second form of this metre wherein the first pause comes at the 13th matra, the second at the final 15th and a rəgən at the end of the line. This form is also known as səțpəta and pedi (peri). Example: “phır kər səgre nəgər me, mərdana ur ǝkularke, bethe şri nanək jəhã, təhı thǝkıt su besyo arke, sri mukh so bujhət bhǝye, tıh bədənəhı bıkəl nıharke, bın rəbab avən bhayo, nıj bırtha bhənəhu sudharke.”-NP. | long_definition |
| 5158 | ਹਰਿਦਰਸਨ | 6 | 90 | intuitive vision of the supreme One through self-realization. 2 philosophy of Sikhism, doctrine of the faith articulated by Guru Nanak Dev. “hərıdərsənu ਪਾਵੈ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ.”–asa m 3. 3 Sikh religion. “hərīdərsən ke jən mukətī nə māgəhī.”–kəlī ə m 4. | long_definition |
| 5159 | ਹਰਿਦਿਬਾਨ | 5 | 90 | the court of the Creator, religious congregation, or community of the Sikhs. “jo milīā hərī dībān siu, so səbhnī dībānī milīā.”–var srī m 4. ‘He who is a member of the Sikh congregation is a member of every religious community of the world.’ | long_definition |
| 5160 | ਹਰਿਦਿਵਾਨ | 5 | 90 | the court of the Creator, religious congregation, or community of the Sikhs. “jo milīā hərī dībān siu, so səbhnī dībānī milīā.”–var srī m 4. ‘He who is a member of the Sikh congregation is a member of every religious community of the world.’ | long_definition |
| 5161 | ਹਾਤਿਮਤਾਈ | 5 | 90 | an Arab chief of Tai descent who was very prudent, benevolent and pious. He lived before Prophet Mohammad was born. His benign book of sermons has been translated into many languages, including Persian, Urdu, English etc. | long_definition |
| 5162 | ਹਿੰਦੁਸਤਾਨ | 5 | 90 | ਹਿੰਦੁਸਤਾਨੁ [hīdustanu] the place where Hindus reside; a country which is especially populated by Hindus. So many names have been assigned to it, such as Aryavarat, Bharat etc. Hidustan is surrounded by Himalaya and the ocean. Lengthwise it is 1900 miles while its breadth is 1500 miles. Total area is 1,805,332 square miles. 1,094, 300 square miles of it is British territory while the remaining area is under the control of native states. The number of large and small native states put together comes to 666. Nine parts of the population of Hindustan is rural while one part is urban. There are 2,316 cities, out of which 31 are metropolitan, with population of more than one lac each. The total number of villages is 685,665. Hindustan is fifteen times larger than Great Britain. If USSR is excluded from Europe, then the rest of its area is equal to that of Hindustan. According to the 1921 census, Hindustan’s total population is 318,475,480 (247,003,293 in British territory and 71,939,187 in the native states). But of this population, 163,995,554 is male and 154,946,926 is female. Religion wise the number is as follows:- Christians 4,754,000 Sikhs 3,229,000 Hindus 216,735,000 Jains 1,178,000 Parsees 102,000 Tribals 9,775,000 Bodhs 11,571,000 Muslims 68,735,000 Jews 22,000 The total number of widows in Hindustan is 20,250,075. In other words there are 175 widows for 1000 women. A total of 222 languages are spoken in India. The important languages and the number of their speakers are given below:- Hindi (western Hindi) 96,714,000 Kanari (kanrhi) 10,374,000 Gujarati 9,552,000 Tamil 18,780,000 Telgu 23,601,000 Punjabi 16,234,000 Western Punjabi 5,652,000 Bengali 49,294,000 Brahmi 8,423,000 Marhati 18,798,000 Rajsthani 12,681,000 The administration is under the control of the Viceroy. There are two councils for managing its affairs. One is the Council of State while the other is Legislative Assembly. There are fifteen provincial governments under the central government. These are governed by their respective governors. Provincial governments are of dual nature. One is the real council, which controls some important departments, while the other consists of two or three ministers, who are answerable to the legal council. | long_definition |

| 6279 | ਟਾਹਲੀਸਾਹਿਬ | 6 | 87 | and sat under a rosewood tree. As a result, this holy place is popularly known as Tahla Sahib. That tree has withered away now. Manji Sahib of Guru Tegbahadur is also set up in a room. Patiala state has donated 250 ghumaons of land to the gurdwara. This holy place is one and a half miles to the south of Maurh railway station. | long_definition, missing_clean_romanization |
| 6280 | ਬੰਦਾਬਹਾਦੁਰ | 6 | 87 | On reaching Punjab, Gurbaksh Singh worked as per the dictums of the Guru. Those who had defied the Guru were heavily punished by him. | 7691 | ਹੁਸੈਨਾਬਾਦ | 5 | 81 | a town in the district of Gaya (Bihar) “hira si husenabad.”—əkal. | possible_name_or_place |
| 7692 | ਹੋਸੰਗਾਬਾਦ | 5 | 81 | a prominent city of a district at the bank of river Nərbada in Central India (CP.), which is 476 miles from Bombay. | possible_name_or_place |
| 7693 | ਅਗਨਾਯੁਧ | 5 | 80 | n ਆਯਾਸ੍ਵ, ਅਗਨਿ-ਅਸਤ੍ਰ, ਅਗਨਿਯੁਧ. In the Purans there goes a story that a missile fired with the recitation of Agni mantar (a spell of fire) reduces foes to ashes, See ਅਗਨਿਯੁਧ. 2 a musket, gun, fire-arms. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7694 | ਅਮਰਬੇਲ | 5 | 80 | See ਅੰਬਰ ਵੱਲੀ n dodder cascuta apidendron; a parasite plant which grows and spreads on tree branches and lives by sipping their juice, and is also called vrıkşadni (eater of a tree). See ਅਕਾਸਬੇਲ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7695 | ਅਲਲਾਚੀਨ | 5 | 80 | Skt n a sea adjoining China. 2 per Janamsakhi, a mountain on the Chinese sea coast. 3 Bhai Santokh Singh has described the anal bird as al-lachin. “əl-lacin bıhəg jıh thanə.”–NP. See ਅਲਲ 4. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7696 | ਉਪਅਵਤਾਰ | 6 | 80 | a secondary incarnation, inferior to the primary one. See ਉਪ. “əb gəno upəvtar.”–brəhəm. Ram, Krishan, Kalki etc. are primary avtars: Vyas, Prithu etc. are regarded as secondary ones. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7697 | ਉਪਪੁਰਾਣ | 5 | 80 | minor Purans or books of Hindu mythology. They are 18 in number: usna, sənətkumar, ਸ਼ਬ, shev, ਕਪਿਲ, ਕਾਲਿਕਾ, durvasa, devi, narsīgh, nardiy, ਨੰਦੀਕੇਸ਼੍ਵਰ, paraşər, padm, bhaskər, ਮਹੇਸ਼੍ਵਰ, maric, vayviy and varun, See ਯਾਰ.² | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7698 | ਕਤਲਗੜ੍ਹੀ | 6 | 80 | a mansion (a large walled house) of Sain Budhushah in the mohalla of Saihwani Sayyeds of Sadhaura; Banda Bahadur assassinated hundreds of Muslims who had gathered there. See ਬੁੱਧੂਸ਼ਾਹ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7699 | ਕਰਤਾਰਨ | 5 | 80 | rays of the sun; rays of the sun to dispel darkness of ignorance. “kərtarən se subh vak vılas.”–NP. 2 clapping. “bırhõg vıkarən ko kərtarən.”–NP. See ਡਾਵਤ. 3 kərtar- hən. are the doers, are the makers. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7700 | ਖਰਗਸਿੰਘ | 5 | 80 | a great warrior and a friend of Jarasandh. In Krishanavtar its meaning is thus explained: “kharəg ramyatənu gərmita sīghnad ghəmsan. pāc bərən ko gun liyo īh bhupatī balvan.” See ਖਰਗਸਿੰਘ and ਗਰਮਿਤਾ ਸੇਖ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7701 | ਖ੍ਵਾਜਖਿਦਰ | 6 | 80 | P خواجہ خضر a prophet. See ਖਿਜ਼ਰ. 2 lord of greenery, god of verdure, master of water, god Varun, Neptune. See ਈਸ਼ਕ. 3 a Muslim holyman, who is also known as Zindahpir. See ਜ਼ਿੰਦਾਪੀਰ and ਦਰਯਾਪੰਥੀ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7702 | ਖ੍ਵਾਜਖਿਜ਼ਰ | 6 | 80 | P خواجہ خضر a prophet. See ਖਿਜ਼ਰ. 2 lord of greenery, god of verdure, master of water, god Varun, Neptune. See ਈਸ਼ਕ. 3 a Muslim holyman, who is also known as Zindahpir. See ਜ਼ਿੰਦਾਪੀਰ and ਦਰਯਾਪੰਥੀ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7703 | ਚਾਰਚਰਣ | 5 | 80 | n animal, quadruped. “carcərən kəhəhı bəhu agər.”–gəu kəbir. 2 four parts, four sections. 3 four foundations (pillars) of religion. See ਚਾਰ ਪਗ and ਧਰਮ ਦੇ ਚਾਰ ਚਰਣ. 4 four lines of a poetic metre. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7704 | ਚਾਰਚਰਨ | 5 | 80 | n animal, quadruped. “carcərən kəhəhı bəhu agər.”–gəu kəbir. 2 four parts, four sections. 3 four foundations (pillars) of religion. See ਚਾਰ ਪਗ and ਧਰਮ ਦੇ ਚਾਰ ਚਰਣ. 4 four lines of a poetic metre. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7705 | ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ | 5 | 80 | n the Creator of the world; the Lord who provides consciousness to the world. “jəgjivən sıu apı cıtu lae.”—bəsət m 3. “ape jəgjivən sukhdata.”—sri m 3. 2 living in the world. 3 See ਸਤਨਾਮੀ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7706 | ਜਲਾਲਖਾਨ | 5 | 80 | Emperor Aurangzeb’s commander who was subordinate to commander-in-chief Hussaini and fought against hill chieftains to recover tribute. “ləe gurəj cəllə su jəlalkhanə.”—VN ə 11. 2 See ਜਲਾਲਾਬਾਦ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7707 | ਤੁਰੀਆਗੁਣ | 5 | 80 | n stage of true knowledge or self realisation, stage of acquiring true knowledge. See ਤੁਰੀਆ. “ਤ੍ਰੇਗੁਨ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੋਹੀ ਵ੍ਯਾਪੈ ਤਰੀਆ ਗੁਨ ਹੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਲਹਿਆ.”—ਬਿਲਾ ਏ m 4. “turiavəstha gurmukhı ਪਾਇ ਸਤਸੱਭਾ ਕਿ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ.”—asa m 1. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7708 | ਤੁਰੀਆਪਦ | 5 | 80 | n stage of true knowledge or self realisation, stage of acquiring true knowledge. See ਤੁਰੀਆ. “ਤ੍ਰੇਗੁਨ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੋਹੀ ਵ੍ਯਾਪੈ ਤਰੀਆ ਗੁਨ ਹੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਲਹਿਆ.”—ਬਿਲਾ ਏ m 4. “turiavəstha gurmukhı ਪਾਇ ਸਤਸੱਭਾ ਕਿ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ.”—asa m 1. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7709 | ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ | 6 | 80 | n stage of true knowledge or self realisation, stage of acquiring true knowledge. See ਤੁਰੀਆ. “ਤ੍ਰੇਗੁਨ ਮਾਯਾ ਮੋਹੀ ਵ੍ਯਾਪੈ ਤਰੀਆ ਗੁਨ ਹੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਲਹਿਆ.”—ਬਿਲਾ ਏ m 4. “turiavəstha gurmukhı ਪਾਇ ਸਤਸੱਭਾ ਕਿ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ.”—asa m 1. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7710 | ਤ੍ਰਜਥਡੂ | 5 | 80 | See चैथष्टी रा डेर 1. | reference_or_inflection, missing_clean_romanization |
| 7711 | ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾਂਤਕ | 5 | 80 | the author of Sastarnammala has wrongly written ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾਂਤਕ for ਤ੍ਰਾਤਾਂਤਕ See ਸਨਾਮਾ 395; water, the destroyer of earth. 2 terminator of the second aeon – (ਤ੍ਰੇਤਾ [treta]); the third aeon dvapər. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7712 | ਧਰਮਧੁਜਾ | 5 | 80 | n standard (flag) of religion; emblem of religion, symbol of religion. 2 flag of the monastery of saints belonging to the Nirmala sect. See ਮਸਤ and ਨਿਰਮਲੇ. 3 a flag having signs in consonance with religious practice. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7713 | ਨਰਮਦੇਸ਼ | 5 | 80 | Skt ਨਰਮਦੇਸ਼ Shivling installed by Narmada in Kashi. See ਵਾਪਤੀ ਧੰਡ ǝ 92. 2 Shivling shaped stone got from Narmada. As shalgrams emerge from Gandki in the same manner Shivlings are found in Narmada. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7714 | ਪਰਗ੍ਰਹ | 5 | 80 | ਪਰਗ੍ਰਿਹ [pərgṛih], ਪਰਗ੍ਰੀਹ [pərgṛīhu] Skt ਪਰਗ੍ਰਹ other’s house. 2 other’s wife. “jesā səg bisiər sū he re! teso hī īhu pərgṛīhu.”—asā m 5. “lobhədī drisəṭī pərgṛīhā.”—gujjedev. 3 See ਪਰਗ੍ਰਿਹ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7715 | ਪਰਵਰਿਅਉ | 6 | 80 | adj changed into another form, was transformed. See ਪਰਵਰਿਅਉ. 2 encircled, surrounded. “osū šorī namonīdhən hɛ, namo pərvərīa.”—var sri m 4. 3 covered, hidden, protected. 4 brought up, reared. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |

| 7718 | ਪਰਹਰਣ | 5 | 80 | ਪਰਹਰਨ [pərhərən] Skt ਪਰਿਹਰਣ n act of snatching, grabbing. 2 renunciation. “kuləkhņi pərhərı chodi bhətar.”—var guj 1 m 3. 3 eradicating, removing. “jese jələdhı barı pərhərɛ.”—cərıtr 297. 4 See ਪ੍ਰਹਰਣ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7719 | ਪਰਹਰਨ | 5 | 80 | Skt ਪਰਿਹਰਣ n act of snatching, grabbing. 2 renunciation. “kuləkhņi pərhərı chodi bhətar.”—var guj 1 m 3. 3 eradicating, removing. “jese jələdhı barı pərhərɛ.”—cərıtr 297. 4 See ਪ੍ਰਹਰਣ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7720 | ਰਤਨਾਕਰ | 5 | 80 | Skt रत्नाकर. n mine of gems, source of gems. 2 ocean. 3 See ਰਤਨਾਗਰ. 4 residents of Rameshvar use this name for the sea, which, rising from the west, meets with the ocean on the east. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7721 | ਰਤਨਾਕਰੁ | 5 | 80 | Skt रत्नाकर. n mine of gems, source of gems. 2 ocean. 3 See ਰਤਨਾਗਰ. 4 residents of Rameshvar use this name for the sea, which, rising from the west, meets with the ocean on the east. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7722 | ਰਤਨਾਗਰ | 5 | 80 | See ਰਤਨਾਕਰ. "guru bohith tare ratnagǝru."-asa m 5. 'helps to swim across the mine of gems.' 2 adj having the power to produce gems. "tű sagro ratnagro, həu sar nə jaņa teri."-suhi chət m 5. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7723 | ਰਤਨਾਗਰੁ | 5 | 80 | See ਰਤਨਾਕਰ. "guru bohith tare ratnagǝru."-asa m 5. 'helps to swim across the mine of gems.' 2 adj having the power to produce gems. "tű sagro ratnagro, həu sar nə jaņa teri."-suhi chət m 5. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7724 | ਲਿਖਣਸਰ | 5 | 80 | a pond, in Damdama Sahib (Sabo Ki Talwandi) in which Guru Gobind Singh used to throw the reed-pens. When asked by the Sikhs, he replied that excellent writers of Gurmat would appear there. See (e) of ਦਮਦਮਾ ਸਾਹਿਬ 1. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7725 | ਲੋਹਪਾਤ੍ਰ | 5 | 80 | iron pot. In Sikhism, this pot is very sacred. The nectar (for the initiatory rites) is prepared in an iron bowl. In Hinduism iron pot is taken as extremely impure. See ਅਤ੍ਰਿਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸ਼: 150. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7726 | ਵਾਤਸਲ੍ਯ | 5 | 80 | Skt ਵਾਤਸਲ੍ਯ. n affection (for the offspring), tenderness. The Bhagats (devotees) have regarded this emotion more important than the other nine ones of a poetic composition. See ਵਸ 9. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7727 | ਵਿਜਯਾਦਸ਼ਮੀ | 6 | 80 | 10th day of the bright half of the month of Assu. In books on Hinduism, this day is regarded auspicious as of triumph over evil.¹ Ramchandar left for his victory over Lanka, on this day. See ਰਮਵਾ 2. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7728 | ਵ੍ਯਵਸਥਾ | 5 | 80 | See ਬਿਵਸਥਾ 3. | reference_or_inflection, missing_clean_romanization |
| 7729 | ਵ੍ਯਾਕਰਣ | 5 | 80 | Skt हि-भा-वि. n analysis,separation. 2 The treatise that imparts knowl-edge of verbal roots of the words and by whichtheir correct forms and usages are known. Aਸਰਫ਼ੋਨਹਵ. E Grammar. See ਅਸਟ ਸਾਜਿ ਸਾਜਿ 3. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7730 | ਸਤਧਨਵਾ | 5 | 80 | n शतधन्वन् n a Yadav bearing one hundred bows. He was the son of Hridak. He killed Satrajit the father-in-law of Krishan. Hence Krishan chopped off his head with a circular boomerang. See ਸਤਧਾਨਾ and ਧਨੁਸ਼. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7731 | ਸਤ੍ਰਾਜਿਤ | 5 | 80 | n son of Nighan Yadav. Pleased with him, the sun gifted him the syəmətək gem. See ਸਤਪਤਾ and ਸਤਭਾਮਾ. “sətrajıt ləkh bhed nəhı.”—krısən. In Dasam Granth, Arijit and Aranjit are mentioned as its synonyms. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7732 | ਸਲਾਮਾਲੇਕ | 5 | 80 | ਸਲਾਮਾਲੇਕਮ [səlamalekəm], ਸਲਾਮਾਲੇਕੀ [səlamaleki], ਸਲਾਮਾਲੇਖੁ [səlamalekhu] See ਸਲਾਮ. “səlamalekəm mukhõ əlavë.”—GPS. “milde musəlman duı mıl mıl kərən səlamaleki.”—BG. “vir, səlamalekhu.”—s m l bəno. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7733 | ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤ | 6 | 80 | Skt सहस्कृत adj confirmed. 2 provoked. 3 Skt संस्कृत refined. 4 a language regulated according to grammar and refined as compared to a spoken language. 5 n Sanskrit; the divine utterance. 6 See ਸਹਸਕ੍ਰਿਤੀ and ਸਹਸਾ ਕਿਰਤਾ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7734 | ਸਹਸ੍ਰਾਕਸ਼ | 6 | 80 | n one having a thousand eyes, God. See ਸਹਸ੍ਰ and ਸਹਸ੍ਰ. 2 Indar. According to the legend, one thousand vaginal spots appeared on the body of Indar due to Gautam rishi's curse, which later on turned into eyes. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7735 | ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ | 5 | 80 | See ਸਾਧਸਮਾਗ. “sadhsāngətī upje bisvās.”—gau thītī kəbīr. “sadhsāngətī ke ǝclī lāvhu.”—jet m 5. 2 Bhai Nand Lal describes Sikh religion as “sadhsāng”. “həmcunā dər məzhəbe ī sadhsāng.”—jīdgī. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7736 | ਸਾਧਸੰਗਮ | 5 | 80 | See ਸਾਧਸਮਾਗ. “sadhsāngətī upje bisvās.”—gau thītī kəbīr. “sadhsāngətī ke ǝclī lāvhu.”—jet m 5. 2 Bhai Nand Lal describes Sikh religion as “sadhsāng”. “həmcunā dər məzhəbe ī sadhsāng.”—jīdgī. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7737 | ਸੁਆਵਗੀਰ | 5 | 80 | P ਸਾਵਗੀਰ keepers of pure gold i.e. pure coins. See ਸੁਆਵੈ 2. “ja sətīguru səraphu nədərī kərī dekhe, suavgir səbhī ughəriae.”—var gəu 1 m 4. ‘The pure have been distinguished from the counterfeit.’ | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7738 | ਸੁਵਰਚਲਾ | 5 | 80 | Skt ਸੁਵਰਚਲਾ n daughter of Vishavkarma, wife of the sun; her other name is Sangya. When she assumed the form of a mare, then from the sun she gave birth to Ashvini Kumar, an angel. See ਛਟਿਆ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7739 | ਸ੍ਤ੍ਰੀਧਨ | 5 | 80 | Skt n a dowry or cash, ornaments and garments etc. received by a girl at the time of marriage, or those assets which are particularly given by her father and husband etc. See ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਧਨ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7740 | ਸ੍ਵਯੰਵਰ | 5 | 80 | Skt ਸ੍ਵਯੰਵਰ n choice of husband by a princess in a public assembly of suitors. See ਸੀਤਾ and ਦਮਯੰਤੀ ਦੇ ਸ੍ਵਯੰਬਰ. In India the last such function was held by Raja Jai Chand of Kanoj for his daughter Sanyukta. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |

| 7763 | ਅਲਾਉੱਦੀਨ | 5 | 73 | A علاؤالدین adj who uplifts religion. 2 king of the Khilji dynasty who ruled at Delhi from Sammat 1353 to 1373. He got the dome-like gate near Qutab Minar built in Delhi in 1310 AD. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |

| 7765 | ਉੱਚਰਵਾਈਸ਼ | 6 | 73 | n the owner of this horse. "uccsrəvais es esņi ısņi ərıņi."-sənama. 'Uchshrav is owned by Indar, his master is Kashyap, earth is his property, his protection is by the king's army, the gun is his enemy.' | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7766 | ਕੰਤਨਗਰ | 5 | 73 | Kahalgaon; a village at a distance of ten kohs to the east of district Bhagalpur. Guru Teg Bahadur stayed here. The gurdwara there is under the supervision of the Mahant of Patna Sahib. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7767 | ਚੱਕਭਾਈਕੇ | 5 | 73 | Chakk Phate Singh is also called Chakk Bhai Ke. 2 a village near Budhlada railway station district Karnal owned by Bhai ke. In Sammat 1899, the village was founded by Bhai Masadda Singh, a descendant of Bhai Bhagtu. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7768 | ਜਗਤਪਿਤਾ | 5 | 73 | n the Creator of the world, the supreme One. “jəgətpıta he sərəb pran ko ədhar.”–səvɛye sri mukhvak m 5. 2 Brahma. “jəgətpıta pəd prithəm kəhı sut pəd ət bəkhan.”–sənama. jəgətpıta (Brahma) sut (son); river Brahmputra. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7769 | ਜਨਮਪਤ੍ਰ | 6 | 73 | n the document that carries the mention of a person’s birth time, birth day, year of birth, the stars and planets, and the determination of their auspicious and inauspicious influence; horoscope. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7770 | ਜਨਮਪਤ੍ਰੀ | 6 | 73 | n the document that carries the mention of a person’s birth time, birth day, year of birth, the stars and planets, and the determination of their auspicious and inauspicious influence; horoscope. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7771 | ਜੈਸਲਮੇਰੁ | 5 | 73 | Raval Jaisal (Jaishal) son of Dusaj, a Bhatti Rajput of Yadav dynasty, who was a renowned raja. He established Jaisalmer town in Rajputana after his name in 1146 AD. Phool dynasty also originated from Jaisal. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7772 | ਠਗਣਹਾਰ | 5 | 73 | adj cheat. 2 n cheat. 3 one who has attained self-realisation. “thəgənhar ənthəgda thage.”—ram m 5. ‘Immoral acts, which none can entrap, are taken care of by the spiritually enlightened person.’ | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7773 | ਤਨਖਾਹਨਾਮਾ | 6 | 73 | a scripture written by a devoted Sikh based on a dialogue between Guru Gobind Singh and Bhai Nand Lal. It depicts in detail those acts, the performance of which subjects a person to religious punishment. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7774 | ਪੁਲਸਤ੍ਯ | 5 | 73 | Skt ਪੁਲਸਤ੍ਯ a saint who is counted among the seven saints. He was son of Brahma, father of Vishrva and grandfather of Kuber and Ravan. “agast pulsat bāsīsat te ādī, nā janpāre kīh des sidhāe.” --datt. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7775 | ਬਖਸੀਸਸਿੰਘ | 6 | 73 | a kalaal of village Bharowal under police station Vairowal in tehsil Tarn Taran district Amritsar, baptised by Guru Gobind Singh on Vaisakh 1, Sammat 1756. He fought very bravely in the battles of Anandpur. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7776 | ਬਡੀਸੰਗਤ | 5 | 73 | main holy place, chief shrine. The main centre of worship, in a city where there is a large number of holy places is so called; for example, there exists vədi səgət in cities like Sasaram and Calcutta. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7777 | ਬਦਨਜਰ | 5 | 73 | P ਬਦਨਜ਼ਰ n evil eye. The Hindus believe that the sight of a wicked person has ill-effect upon the other. According to a writing in Mishkaat, Hazarat Mohammad was also a believer in the evil eye. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7778 | ਬਦਨਦਰੀ | 5 | 73 | P ਬਦਨਜ਼ਰ n evil eye. The Hindus believe that the sight of a wicked person has ill-effect upon the other. According to a writing in Mishkaat, Hazarat Mohammad was also a believer in the evil eye. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7779 | ਭ੍ਰਮਗਿਆਨੀ | 6 | 73 | one having no knowledge of self-realisation, one having superficial knowledge; such a person regards himself as a great scholar even if he is all ignorant. "pərzo kalu səbhe jag upərı, mahı lıkhe bhrəmgrani."-sor kəbir. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7780 | ਮਨਸੂਰਪੁਰ | 6 | 73 | the name of Chhitanwa-la² situated five kohs to the west of Nabha, falling under police station Bhawanigarh, sub-division Sunam of Patiala state. It was found-ed by Rajput of Mansoor Ali Khan of Kakrha. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7781 | ਮੁਗਲਪੁਰਾ | 5 | 73 | a colony near Lahore, which is also a cantonment. It falls in tehsil and district Lahore. The holy place Chubbacha Guru Ram Rai in memory of Baba Ram Rai is situated in this village. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7782 | ਮੁੰਗੀਪਟਨ | 5 | 73 | a town in district Vizagpatam in Madras. Mungapatam. The name of this town is derived from the phrase mūgi da dana, according to the tales described in Dasam Granth, viz – “dıgər danəh ra bəsət mügipətən.”–həkayət 2. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7783 | ਮੁੰਗੀਪੱਟਨ | 5 | 73 | a town in district Vizagpatam in Madras. Mungapatam. The name of this town is derived from the phrase mūgi da dana, according to the tales described in Dasam Granth, viz – “dıgər danəh ra bəsət mügipətən.”–həkayət 2. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7784 | ਰਾਮਦਾਸਪੁਰ | 6 | 73 | Amritsar City. Guru ka Chakk. "vəsdi səghən əpar ənup ramdaspur." -phunhe m 5. Guru Arjan Dev named this town as Ramdaspur, but it has come to be known as Amritsar on account of the fame of the pond. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7785 | ਰਾਮਨਿਵਾਜੀਏ | 6 | 73 | a group of followers of Bhai Basti Ram, living in Isakhail tehsil of Bannu. They prostrate and recite the name of Ram in the style of Muslim prayer. Their holy scripture is Guru Granth Sahib. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7786 | ਲੱਜਵਰਦ | 5 | 73 | P ਲਾਜਵਰਦ Skt ਰਾਜਵਰਤ. n rust-coloured precious stone used in various medicines, Lapis Lazuli. 2 sulphur-mixed indigo. 3 Per Nanak Prakash and Janamsakhi, king of Habash who became a votary of Guru Nanak Dev. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7787 | ਸੁਰਾਗਾਬਾਦ | 5 | 73 | It is another name for Sarangpur. This town is in Devasaraj of Central India (C.P.) Once a famous place, it is mentioned in many chronicles. “sora si surāgabad nike rahi jhulke.”–akal. | possible_name_or_place, long_definition |
| 7788 | ਅਕਾਸਬੇਲ | 5 | 62 | n əmərbel; a dodder, cascuta apidendron or cassyta filiformis, or cascuta reflexa; a parasitic creeper. It is soft, without thorns and yellow and red in colour. It strikes its root in the bark of whichever tree it creeps upon. As a result, the sap of the tree dries up. See ਅਮਰਬੇਲ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7789 | ਅਗਨਵਾਯੂ | 5 | 62 | Skt ਅਗਨਿਵਾਯੂ. a kind of fever accompanied with pimples on the body; its basic cause is disorder of heat in the stomach caused by excessive salt, sour, raw or overripe fruits, chillies, condiments, liquor and other intoxicants. The patient’s appetite decreases, nausea sets in, body aches, more thirst follows and burning sensation is caused in the forehead. If not cured early, many ailments such as spruce, diarrhoea, dysentery, colic pain, flatulence, etc., come to seize the patient. To cure it, a mild purgative be given and vomiting induced, but such medicines as cause burning sensation in the stomach had better be avoided. A mixture of ophelia charitta, adhatoda vasica, bitter, patol patra (trichosauthess cucumerina), haritaki (myrobalan), balela (torminalia belerica), aula (emblic myrobalan), talchandan (red santalum album), bark of nimm (melia azadirachta) each taken in equal quantity, thoroughly boiled and sieved, when given in small measure to the patient proves beneficial, See ਅਗਨਿਬਾਇ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7790 | ਅਗਨਿਕੁੰਟ | 5 | 62 | n ਅਗਨਿ ਕੂਟ an intermediate direction between the east and the south, southeast. 2 Skt n ਅਗ੍ਨਿਕੁਣ੍ਡ a firepit formed with special specifications for performing a sacrifice and oblation. See ਅਗਨਿਕੁੰਡ. 3 belly's pit where resides; the fire of the womb. “əgənıküț məhı urədh liv laga.”—bera m 4. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7791 | ਅਗਨਿਬਾਣ | 5 | 62 | n In the magical treatises and the Purans, it is mentioned as an arrow shot with the recitation of the fire mantar which burns the army and equipment of the foe. See ਅਸਤ੍ਰ. 2 a bomb or missile of the sort. 3 According to Bernier rotating fire reels were fired to frighten the elephants. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7792 | ਅਜਪਾਜਾਪ | 5 | 62 | n mental recitation without the help of the tongue. “əjəpa jap nə visre.” —var mala m 1. “atəm updes bhes sɔjəm ko jap su əjəpa jape.”—həjare 10. 2 adj recitation of the transcendent Creator. 3 recitation without the aid of a rosary. 4 See ਅਜਪਾ 3. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7793 | ਅਥਰਵਣ | 5 | 62 | Skt ਅਥਰ੍ਵਨ n the fourth Ved, See ਵੇਦ. 2 a sage mentioned in Rig Ved. He is mentioned as the son of Brahma, and his Brahman progeny is known as Athravan, who consider themselves supreme in conducting sacrificial rituals etc. “bhar əthərbən gurumukh tara.”—BG. ‘Devotees of the Guru have taken away the burden of Athravan ritualists.’ | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7794 | ਅਥਰਵਨ | 5 | 62 | Skt ਅਥਰ੍ਵਨ n the fourth Ved, See ਵੇਦ. 2 a sage mentioned in Rig Ved. He is mentioned as the son of Brahma, and his Brahman progeny is known as Athravan, who consider themselves supreme in conducting sacrificial rituals etc. “bhar əthərbən gurumukh tara.”—BG. ‘Devotees of the Guru have taken away the burden of Athravan ritualists.’ | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7795 | ਅਰਥਾਪੱਤੀ | 5 | 62 | Skt अर्थापत्ति n understanding the unsaid meaning; an instance of verification when one statement automatically proves another, as 'it rains' automatically proves that the sky is overcast. See ਅਰਥ. 2 a figure of meaning in poetry. See ਕਾਰਥਾ ਪੱਤੀ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7796 | ਅਸਟਾਇਧ | 5 | 62 | ਅਸ੍ਵ-ਆਯੁਧ. eight weapons of war. “əstardh cəmke.”–əkaļ. eight weapons in Durga’s eight hands, one held in each. “ghəța gəda trisul əsı sək sərasən ban, cəkr bəkr kər me liye jənu grikhəm ritu bhan.” –cədi 1. ‘Bell and conch are also taken as weapons because they help in warfare.’ See ਆਯੁਧ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7797 | ਅਸਟਾਪਦ | 5 | 62 | Skt ਅਸ੍ਵਾਪਦ n gold, which has the highest rank among the eight metals. 2 a grasshopper, an insect with eight feet. 3 a locust. 4 a thorn apple, datura stramonium. 5 Kailash mountain. 6 chess, a game with eight columns, each of eight places. 7 chaupər, a game played with dice. “kıtək kal əsțapəd khela.”—GPS. 8 an eight-footed animal having four feet on the side of the chest and four on the back. See ਸਿਮਆਰ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7798 | ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰੁ | 6 | 62 | See ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਸਰ. 2 a holy congregation; a community of holy men. "əmritsaru sıphti da ghəru." 3 a sacred tank of liberation. "sətıguru he əmrıtsər saca."-majh ǝ m 3. 4 self-knowledge. 5 embodiment of self. "kaza ədərı əmritsər saca."-maru solhe m 3. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7799 | ਇਸਤਿਲਾਹ | 5 | 62 | A ਇਸਤਿਲਾਹ consultation. 2 a technical term, or phrase, having a special meaning, such as 'deg teg' (literally kettle and sword) meaning feeding and destruction of enemies to continue, as the goal of the Khalsa. See ਖਾਲਸੇ ਦੇ ਬੋਲੇ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7800 | ਉੱਚਸ੍ਰਵਾ | 5 | 62 | Skt उच्चैःश्रवस् n one who has high ears, such horse of Indar is white, which is in colour. According to the Purans, it emerged when gods and demons churned the ocean. "ucc srəvah səman nırət kərət."-prichat. See ਉੱਚਸ੍ਰਵਇਸ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7801 | ਏਕਾਕ੍ਸ਼ਰੀ | 5 | 62 | See ਏਕ ਅੱਖਰੀ. 2 a Sankrit dictionary, giving meanings of one lettered nouns. It was compiled by a scholar Purushotam Dev. In Hindi Nand Das has also provided several meanings of each word in couplets, as for example. Example: “go īdri go vak jəl go əkaş dısı chəd, go dhər go tǝru go kırən go palək gobīd.” | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7802 | ਕਲ੍ਹਰਾਇ | 5 | 62 | a chieftain of Raikot (district Ludhiana) who was raja of Tihara territory near Jagraon. He was a devotee of Guru Gobind Singh. The Guru reached Raikot from Machhivara disguised as a Muslim pir. He gave him all the resources at his disposal. He sent his shepherd Nuru to Sirhind who brought the news of the martyrdom of the Guru’s younger sons. The Guru bestowed a sword to Kalharay and bade him to keep it with reverence. Kalhe obeyed him to the full but his grandson donned the sword during hunting. After getting injured with it, he died the same day by falling from a horse. People of Kalha's community now live in Raikot. Two articles of the Guru are with them: one is a jug for containing sacred water and the other is a rehəl, a folding book-stand. See ਟਾਹਲੀਆਣਾ and ਰਾਯਕੋਟ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7803 | ਕਲ੍ਹਰਾਯ | 5 | 62 | a chieftain of Raikot (district Ludhiana) who was raja of Tihara territory near Jagraon. He was a devotee of Guru Gobind Singh. The Guru reached Raikot from Machhivara disguised as a Muslim pir. He gave him all the resources at his disposal. He sent his shepherd Nuru to Sirhind who brought the news of the martyrdom of the Guru’s younger sons. The Guru bestowed a sword to Kalharay and bade him to keep it with reverence. Kalhe obeyed him to the full but his grandson donned the sword during hunting. After getting injured with it, he died the same day by falling from a horse. People of Kalha's community now live in Raikot. Two articles of the Guru are with them: one is a jug for containing sacred water and the other is a rehəl, a folding book-stand. See ਟਾਹਲੀਆਣਾ and ਰਾਯਕੋਟ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7804 | ਕਾਰਤਿਕੇਯ | 5 | 62 | Skt son of Shiv. See ਸਕੰਦ. It is written in Brahmvaivarat that during sexual intercourse with Parvati, Shiv’s semen fell on the earth, the earth put it in the fire, the fire deposited it in the bushes of the elephant-grass (reeds). From this was born his six headed son, whom the moon’s wife breastfed. Thus he came to be known by this name. He was born to kill Tarkasur. He is warrior among gods. Kartikey has been called Tarkari as well. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7805 | ਕ੍ਸ਼ਤ੍ਰਿਯ | 5 | 62 | Skt ਕ੍ਸ਼ਤ੍ਰਿਯ n a powerful man. According to the Hindus, the second caste of the society, who defend their subjects through the use of physical force. In Veds, Purans and Simritis, the origin of Khatris is described as from the Creator's arm. See ਖਟ੍ਰੀ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7806 | ਕੰਠਾਭੂਸਣ | 5 | 62 | See ਕੰਠਾਭਰਣ. 2 a metre characterized by four lines, each having three bhəgəṇs, two gurus, organised as Sll, Sll, Sll, SS. Example: “bhərtkumar nə əhəṭh kije, jah ghərẽ nə həmɛ dukh dije, raj kəhyo ju həmɛ həm mani, trəyədəş bərkh bəsẽ bəndhani.” —ramav. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7807 | ਖਟਦਰਸ | 5 | 62 | षड्दर्शन six systems of Hindu philosophy. See घटमामडू "car bed khətdərəs səmasi.”--var maru 2 m 5. 'Four Veds and six philosophical systems will vanish." "khətdərsən vərte vǝrtara. gur ka dərsən əgəm apara."--asa m 3. 2 According to some, the six systems are: नेगी [jogi], jəgəm (moving Shaivite ascetic), jeni, sənyasi, Hindu monks, veragi renunciants and mədari conjurers. But this is not the right view. In a way, any six philosophical systems or their followers can be termed as khətdərsən. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7808 | ਖਟਵਿਕਾਰ | 5 | 62 | षड्विकार See ਖਟ ਉਤਮਿ. 2 See ਖਟਉਤਮ. 3 six states of the body: conception, birth, growth, decay, change and destruction. “jənəm əstı əru vriddhı prəņama. khiņ hon mərno dukh dhama. khət vıkar atəm məhĩ nahi”—NP. 4 six other associated changes: birth, death, hunger, thirst, happiness and sorrow. “khət vıkar jənəməhı əru mərne. Ih şərir ke donəhu vərne. chudha trıkha dui pranən ker. hərəkh şok mən ke jug her.”—GPS. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7809 | ਖਤ੍ਦਰਸਨ | 6 | 62 | षड्दर्शन six systems of Hindu philosophy. See घटमामडू "car bed khətdərəs səmasi.”--var maru 2 m 5. 'Four Veds and six philosophical systems will vanish." "khətdərsən vərte vǝrtara. gur ka dərsən əgəm apara."--asa m 3. 2 According to some, the six systems are: नेगी [jogi], jəgəm (moving Shaivite ascetic), jeni, sənyasi, Hindu monks, veragi renunciants and mədari conjurers. But this is not the right view. In a way, any six philosophical systems or their followers can be termed as khətdərsən. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7810 | ਖਾਨਬਹਾਦੁਰ | 6 | 62 | His real name was Zakriakhan. He was son of Abdul Samad Khan and the father of Shahnwaz. He is referred to as Khanoo among the Khalsa Panth. His role in Sikh history is duly mentioned. See ਖਾਨ. etc. Khanbahadur became governor of Lahore in 1739 AD and died in 1745. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7811 | ਖੜਗਸਿੰਘ | 5 | 62 | a warrior mentioned in Krishanavtar, a part of Dasam Granth. He was friend of Jarasandh and several times defeated Krishan and other commanders, but, at last he was killed through deception. "tıh bhupətı ko mıtr ıkk khərəgsigh tih nam. pere səmər səmudr bəhu məharəthi baldham."-krisən. See ਖੜਗਸਿੰਘ and ਖੜਗਸਿੰਘ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7812 | ਖੜੰਗਜੋਗ | 5 | 62 | Instead of eight, six kinds of Yog are described in Daksh Simriti: pranayam a system of breathing exercise and regulating respiration; ਧਯਾਨ [dhyan] concentration; pratyahar-control over senses; dharņa - concept; tərək - logic; and səmadhı deep meditation. Yog comprising these six kinds is called khərəgyog. 2 six actions of Yog, which form its various practices. See ਖਟ ਕਰਮ 2. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7813 | ਗਜਹਸਤੀ | 5 | 62 | adj (an elephant) who has raised his trunk for trumpeting. “gəj-həsti ke pran udhariǝle.”—mali namdev. There is an ancient story that with his trunk the elephant offered a lotus to the Almighty and pleaded for protection. See ਗਜ 3. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7814 | ਗੁਰਜਮਾਰ | 5 | 62 | See ਗੁਰਜਦਾਰ. royal employees keeping maces. They were authorised to use these for the recovery of dues and penalities from the defaulters. Mace bearing mendicants often used to beat their bodies with maces and get alms by frightening the householders. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7815 | ਗੁਰਦਾਸਪੁਰ | 6 | 62 | district headquarters of Punjab, which is forty-five miles away from Amritsar by rail. Banda Bahadur was captured here by Abdul Samadhkhan with an army comprising about twenty thousand soldiers and was sent to Delhi. See ਬੰਦਾਬਹਾਦੁਰ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7816 | ਗੁਰੂਵਿਲਾਸ | 5 | 62 | There are two well-known books bearing this title: History of the sixth Guru and History of the tenth Guru respectively. The poet who authored the history of the sixth Guru,¹ writes that Bhai Mani Singh narrated the contents to Bhai Bhagat Singh on the banks of Nankiana Sahib Nanaksar. The poet contends that his mentor Dharam Singh then narrated the history to the poet who then versified it. “sətrã sɛ bite təbɛ bərəkh pəjjhətər jan. savən mas Ikis dın gyo sukhəd pəhıcan. sudi pəkkh dın pəcmi şri guru ke pərsad. par bhog gurugath ka kər kəvıta əhılad.” There are twenty-one chapters in this book. See ਗੁਰੂਮਤਸੁਧਾਕਰ ਕਲਾ 4. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7817 | ਗੁਲਾਬਰਾਇ | 5 | 62 | grandson of Surajmall and son of Dalipchand (Guru Hargobind's great grandson). He was a brother of Sayamdas. Alongwith his brother, he took amrit from Guru Gobind Singh. He adopted the religion of Khalsa after the demise of the tenth Guru. Gulab Singh tried to conduct prayers at Anandpur by occupying the seat of Guru Teg Bahadur, but Bhai Gurubakhashdas, head priest of Anandpur, stopped him from this sacriligeous act. "tın ık dın əvılokyo an. thiryo gulabraı gurthan. səhi nə gəi əvəgya her. hath jori bolyo tis ver. than bənavǝhu apən duja. təhã bɛth lije sǝbh puja." The lineage of Gulab Rai did not continue. The Sodhis of Anandpur are descendants of Shyam Singh. See ਸੂਰਜਮਲ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7818 | ਚਕ੍ਰਾਂਕਿਤ | 5 | 62 | Skt ਚਕ੍ਰਾ‌ੰਕਿਤ੍ adj one whose body is marked with Vishnu's cəkkər; stamped with the cəkkər. 2 n a sect of Vaishnavs who stamp their bodies with a hot metal to make the mark of Vishnu (Chakar), in Dwarka or ashram of their guru. For more details See ਪਦਮਪੁਰਾਣ a 251. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7819 | ਚਰਣਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ | 6 | 62 | n nectar (əmrit) from the sacred feet of a deity or Guru; water in which the Guru's feet have been washed. The first nine Sikh Gurus used to initiate new entrants, by administering them water in which the Guru's feet had been washed. It was also called cərəņpahul or pagpahul. See ਚਰਣਾਮ੍ਰਿਤ. | reference_or_inflection, long_definition |
| 7820 | ਚਰਨਪਾਦੁਕਾ | 6 | 62 | See ਚਰਣਪਾਦੁਕਾ. 2 Many gurdwaras of this name exist in the sacred memory of Guru Nanak Dev. | 7821 | ਚਿਤ੍ਰਰੇਖ | 5 | 62 | Skt ਚਿਤ੍ਰਲੇਖਾ daughter of Kooshmand, a minister of Van (Bansur), a superb word picture painter. She was a dear friend of Van's daughter, Usha.
